title: AIOS AutoResearch v0.1 Deterministic Observation Row
description: One observation row per issue #395's Grain: one case_id, run_id, baseline_or_candidate side, configuration, and evaluator version. Governed by ChatGPT/[Analytics]/Knowledge/AUTORESEARCH_STOCHASTICITY_NONINFERIORITY_METHOD.md. This is the deterministic input/output contract #392's comparator consumes; it carries no p-value, confidence interval, or aggregate score field -- issue #395 forbids any such claim unless actually computed under an explicit method, and this method's own method is exact/rule-based, not asymptotic (see the doc's own rationale section).

hard_gate_status.description: Reuses scripts/autoresearch_validator.py's hard_gate_results status vocabulary verbatim (issue #392, widened by #392 with not_run).

normalized_behavior_result.description: Reuses VERDICT_PRECEDENCE's pass/revise/blocked severity mapping (issue #391/#392/#394), or null when the row is missing (missingness_reason must then be set).

target_family_flag.description: true for the one case_family this experiment's mutation targets (autoresearch_experiment_record.research_surface's family); false for every other (non-target) family observed for regression purposes.

paired_delta.description: normalized severity(baseline) - normalized severity(candidate) for this row's matched pair, positive meaning candidate is better; null when unmatched (missingness_reason set) or not yet paired.

run_variance_or_disagreement.description: true if this case's (case_id, baseline_or_candidate) rerun group shows more than one distinct normalized_behavior_result value.

missingness_reason.description: null when the row is complete; otherwise the specific reason it could not contribute a full paired observation.

decision_contribution.description: This row's own vote toward the case's decision -- never itself the batch decision.
